description: The questions behind anything a person does here, with this account's options for each: send a text, buy or release a number, register for 10DLC, verify a toll-free number, request a short code, verification codes, a recurring text, a segment, template, list, topic, connecting a tool, a webhook, an API key, a link domain, a spend limit, a number pool, importing opt-outs, automations, broadcasts. task: a key or the person's words ("buy a number"); omit it for the list. Each question names the fields it fills; inputs lists every field the API takes; rules, gaps, and person_submits for carrier filings (what only the person can accept or sign). Changes nothing.
